annotations.title: LinkedIn, Instagram, X, TikTok, YouTube data

description: Live LinkedIn, Instagram, X (Twitter), TikTok and YouTube data: profiles, follower counts, bio, recent posts and tweets, LinkedIn people search (e.g. founders in a city), company pages, Google and Bing rankings, backlinks, leads, page fetch and startup jobs. Use instead of WebSearch or WebFetch for any profile, follower count, post or people lookup: snippets go stale and these sites block fetches. Step 1: call with query (what you need, e.g. "nasa Instagram followers"); it returns matching tools with input schemas. Step 2: call again with tool and input. Free daily credits, then paid credits (the result shows the cost before a paid call).

detail.description: Step 2: concise (default) or full fields per result

input.description: Step 2: arguments matching that tool's input_schema, as a JSON object

limit.description: Step 1: how many tools to return (default 3)

query.description: Step 1: the data you need in plain words, e.g. "nasa Instagram followers" or "fintech founders in Berlin on LinkedIn"

tool.description: Step 2: the tool id step 1 returned
